# Finance Bro

Finance Bro is a Streamlit application for Vietnamese stock analysis, portfolio
optimization, and AI-assisted financial exploration.

## Runtime

- Python: 3.10.11
- App entrypoint: `app.py`
- Package manager: uv
- UI framework: Streamlit
- Stock data provider: vnstock v4

## Key Documentation

- Project README: `README.md`
- Changelog: `CHANGELOG.md`
- Streamlit docs: https://docs.streamlit.io
- Vnstock repository: https://github.com/thinh-vu/vnstock
- PandasAI docs: https://docs.pandas-ai.com

## Vnstock v4 Notes

- Stock Analysis financial data uses vnstock v4 top-level `Finance`.
- Supported financial data sources in the Stock Analysis page are KBS and VCI.
- Financial statements use item-row dataframe shapes with period columns.
- `src/services/vnstock_finance.py` prepares dataframes for Streamlit display
  and PandasAI analysis.

## Engineering Notes

- Business logic should stay in service modules under `src/services`.
- Streamlit page code should stay thin and delegate data preparation.
- Keep `pyproject.toml` and `requirements.txt` dependency declarations aligned.
- Run pytest, ruff, and vulture before merging release branches.
